placeholder: Search by meaning, model or node…
catalog_tip_add: Choose a folder, configure its file types, and add it to the application as a new search catalog.
catalog_tip_catalog_settings: Change extensions, masks, subfolders, size limit, and image indexing for the selected catalog.
catalog_tip_update: Incrementally process new, changed, failed, and unfinished files. Ready unchanged files are skipped.
catalog_tip_rebuild: Clear the current index and process every file in the selected catalog again. Source files are not changed.
catalog_tip_remove: Remove the selected catalog from the application. Source files and index data remain on disk.
catalog_tip_pause: Temporarily pause active indexing. Click again to continue.
catalog_tip_cancel: Stop the current operation. Files already indexed successfully remain available.
catalog_tip_clear_filter: Restore the general information and complete indexed-file list for the selected catalog.
catalog_tip_find_duplicates: Find files with identical content in the selected catalog by checksum.
catalog_tip_open_file: Open the selected file in its default Windows application.
catalog_tip_open_folder: Open the selected file's folder and highlight the file in Explorer.
catalog_tip_copy_path: Copy the selected file's full path to the clipboard.
rebuild_confirm: Rebuild the index? Source files are preserved.
language_help: Application interface language. Tabs, buttons, descriptions, and tooltips change immediately.
theme_help: Interface color scheme: system, light, or dark.
performance_preset_help: Sets indexing threads, embedding batch size, and preparation queue together. You can fine-tune any of those values afterward.
preset_minimum: Economy — 8–16 GB RAM / up to 6 GB VRAM
preset_minimum_help: 2 threads, batch 32, queue 16. For low-memory systems and CPU mode.
preset_basic_help: 4 threads, batch 64, queue 32. Conservative load for mainstream hardware.
preset_balanced_help: 8 threads, batch 128, queue 64. Recommended starting point for most systems.
preset_high_help: 16 threads, batch 256, queue 128. Higher throughput with increased CPU, RAM, disk, and VRAM use.
preset_maximum_help: 32 threads, batch 512, queue 256. For high-end GPUs and fast SSDs; an oversized CUDA batch is reduced automatically.
index_workers_help: Parallel CPU threads used for reading, hashing, and extracting files. Higher values can prepare files faster but use more CPU, disk bandwidth, and RAM. The recommended value is 8.
batch_help: Text chunks or images sent to the model at once. Larger batches utilize the GPU better but consume more VRAM. Start with 128 on an RTX 5090.
index_queue_size_help: Files prepared ahead of model processing. A larger queue helps keep the GPU busy but consumes more system RAM. The recommended value is 64.
result_count_help: Maximum number of files displayed after one search. This does not affect how many files are indexed or the index size.
provider_help: Lexical performs fast word matching without a neural model. Gemma adds semantic search and Vision support.
device_help: Device used by the neural model. CUDA uses the GPU, CPU uses the processor and system RAM, and Auto selects automatically.
dimension_help: Size of each stored vector. Higher dimensions increase index size and memory use; changing this requires rebuilding indexes.
alpha_notice: Development alpha. Windows and GPU acceptance tests are pending.
local_privacy: Search and processing run locally. Queries and images are not sent to cloud services.
favorite_not_catalog: This file does not belong to a registered catalog.
drag_files_hint: Drag selected files to Explorer or another application
auto_update_help: Periodically checks catalogs and indexes only new, changed, failed, or unfinished files.
auto_update_interval_help: Seconds between automatic catalog checks. Short intervals access the disks more frequently.
rebuild_required_confirm: The model or extractor settings changed. Rebuild the index now? Source files are preserved.
no_results: There are no results to export.
vision_help: Creates visual image embeddings and enables similar-image search. Rebuild the required indexes after enabling it.
ocr_help: Recognizes text in attached images and uses it during search.
keep_model_loaded_help: Speeds up repeated searches. The loaded model uses about 2 GB of VRAM (CUDA) or 3 GB of system RAM (CPU).
vision_requires_gemma: Select the gemma search engine to enable Vision.
vision_catalog_warning: Vision is not ready. You can save this setting, but visual indexing requires Gemma, enabled Vision, and an installed model.
catalog_saved_rebuild: Catalog settings saved. The index must be rebuilt.
minimum_help: Minimum result relevance from 0 to 100%. This is a similarity score, not a statistical probability.
path_filter_help: Keep files whose path contains this text
node_filter_help: For workflows: a node type such as KSampler or LoadImage
model_filter_help: For workflows: a checkpoint, LoRA, UNet, or VAE name
